versions.content: Support for Partial Networking Type: valid Description: System Template shall support the definition of partial network clusters, the mapping of virtual function clusters to partial network clusters and the wakeup information of individual ECUs. Rationale: System Template shall contain all system relevant parameters required for the configuration of a partial network. Dependencies: None identified. Use Case: Describe the size and location of the system wide partial network cluster vector. Supporting Material: –
